title: extension to free download meshy ai models
author: Matheus1008
selftext:
made an browser extension with AI, and made it that you can download any meshy ai model in STL with one click.  
[https://github.com/ChesterTheCatt/meshy-ai-to-stl](https://github.com/ChesterTheCatt/meshy-ai-to-stl)  
here it is

replies.author: Matheus1008
replies.body: will update it later

comments.body: can someone verify if this is legit?

replies.author: Matheus1008
replies.body: u can send it to claude or something to check, i vibecoded the extension, its legit

replies.body: i did it in google chrome, and i put .stl at the end and the file still doesnt open in blender. have you tried it recently?

replies.body: yea i just tried and it worked, in going to update it right now, and u download the updated version

replies.author: SeasonUnhappy4885
replies.body: thanks

replies.author: Matheus1008
replies.body: try downloading the new release, execute setup-vendor again, and try it on chrome

replies.author: SeasonUnhappy4885
replies.body: that is how i had it and it didnt work. im not sure why

replies.author: Matheus1008
replies.body: u said u cant edit the name file? like, put .obj at the end, so it recognizes as a .obj

replies.author: SeasonUnhappy4885
replies.body: i did that and it didnt work

replies.author: Matheus1008
replies.body: try putting the .obj at the end, see if it changes the type of file, and try to import in blender like:  File → Import → Wavefront (.obj)
